gen-gf-tektur-gf-major-mono-display: Major Mono Display glows like neon glass, every curve sweeping open. Tektur heads the page with pipe-cleaner strokes and outsized lowercase, so the monospace lines below feel gently spaced out.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-momo-trust-display: Pipe-cleaner strokes, open curves, outsized lowercase: that is Tektur in a nutshell. Momo Trust Display drifts in below with distant letters and a generous x-height, a sans that leaves the heading room to stand out.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-mukta: Wiry and oversized, Tektur leaves every curve open at the ends. Mukta keeps paragraphs moving with its tall-bodied small letters, a plain sans that stays out of the way over many lines.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-mukta-mahee: Tektur draws pipe-cleaner strokes with generous openings on every curve and lowercase letters that run well beyond the usual size. Tektur grabs attention; Mukta Mahee, chunky and tall, carries the words.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-mukta-malar: Mukta Malar reads approachably, with compressed ascenders that keep the plain sans lines tight. Tektur does the shouting with heavy, cord-like curves, while Mukta Malar quietly handles the reading.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-tiny5: Tiny5 has short-looking ascenders because its body is so tall. Tektur's thickness holds steady around every curve, so on a full page the sans body settles into an easy rhythm beneath it.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-roundo: Bold from the first stroke, Tilt Neon uses a tube-like, constant-width line and a large x-height. Roundo sits lower in height, its sans n keeping arch and stem matched and every small counter unclogged.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-alumni-sans: Compass-pencil consistency, big x-height: Tilt Neon draws a tube-like constant-width stroke with a splayed c terminal and short ascenders. Alumni Sans reads softly, with understated contrast and ascenders barely clearing the x-height.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-anaheim: Pencil-line consistency and a large x-height: that is Tilt Neon. Anaheim sets sans-serif letters in a dense huddle, rounded forms staying open to the side, and the eye slides along.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-arsenal-sc: Commanding, Tilt Neon keeps its terminals the width they began with, a tube-like line with a large x-height. Arsenal SC reads tight and clean, with a light swell in each bowl.
